issues_found.summary: `susi tasks claim` (installed susi 0.21.20) cannot create any claim from a checkout that uses the repo .githooks/pre-push.
issues_found.detail: The claim performs one atomic push of refs/claims/<id>, refs/claim-agents/<AGENT> and refs/claim-generation/current. push-policy (xtask/src/push_policy.rs, since f9174e655) allows refs/claims/, refs/claim-agents/ and refs/closed/ but rejects refs/claim-generation/ ('unsupported ref namespace'), so the whole atomic push fails. Without push-policy on PATH the hook fails closed instead. The CLI reports both as 'claimed concurrently with another agent', which is misleading. Reproduced by feeding the hook record directly to push-policy. Hook was not bypassed; this task proceeded unclaimed with a two-file scope that no other agent holds.
issues_found.owner_suggestion: push-policy owner (T-DOTGITPUBLISHER-1 / dot) or the commercial task-queue owner; claim code moved to susi-commercial-apps in e9914677a
